run_evaluation: run the weakly supervised detection evaluation on a dataset using a pretrained ViT model and linear classifier
run_ncut_object_discovery: run normalized cuts on ViT features to discover object bounding boxes from image patches
create_linear_classifier: create a LinearClassifier module with a single linear layer for classification on top of frozen features
visualize_detection_errors: visualize bounding box and classification errors by saving prediction images to output directories
evaluate_vit_model: evaluate a vision transformer model with intermediate layer features and a linear classifier on validation data
